packageRules.description: The dev release tracks mogenius' `develop` prerelease train, which is unstable by definition. `allowedVersions` keeps it on that train so a stable `x.y.z` (which sorts above any of its prereleases) never gets proposed here

Each ClusterImageCatalog entry is pinned to the postgres major in its `major` field; the image's tag major is the postgres major, so a new postgres major is added as a new entry, never bumped into an existing one
